raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
This PR is part of a stack (oldest at bottom):

* __->__ #44973
* #44972
* #44971
* #44970
* #44969
* #43326
* #43325
* #43171
* #43170
* #43168

Current head `32ca1aeab5`, based on main `2e9b2cacda`. Stack predecessor: #44972. The Files changed tab isolates this PR from its predecessor.

## Motivation

DSPARK with FA4 and unified memory needs physical FULL/SWA page tables refreshed from live allocator mappings on graph replay. Building translated verify metadata outside capture adds scheduler work and launches.

## Modifications

Replayed onto the corrected prerequisites; the launch-size comment reflects the translated gather path.

- Build translated verify tables and sequence metadata in captured work using explicit FULL/SWA virtual-to-physical tensors.
- Make tail clearing an explicit metadata contract and keep lengths-only callers separate.
- Add graph-replay, mapping, strided-storage, and fused-placement tests.
- Admit FA4 for DSPARK with unified memory while preserving the existing EAGLE/DFLASH restrictions.

## CI registration updates

Updated `est_time` in 4 affected test files from observed file-level CI timings, including process/import cost and margin. Existing estimates with sufficient margin are retained. The expanded weekly configurator test also passed all 11 cases in a 30.1-second CPU measurement.

The CI registry check validated 2,960 registrations before landing. An AST comparison confirmed that this follow-up changes registration metadata only. Runtime test measurements elsewhere in this description refer to their stated earlier revisions.

## Accuracy Tests

Earlier combined stack `b550cacde6` adds a test-fixture correction in #43326: the Gemma4 read-stream fixture declares its FULL address space, and the HiSparse registry test uses real `CacheInitParams` for the retained-window calculation. Both complete test files pass locally with GPUs hidden: 4 Gemma4 tests and 26 registry tests. Pre-commit passed. The five descendant patches are unchanged (`git range-diff`); this follow-up changes no production code. The earlier 455-test run did not cover these two files; GitHub CI has not yet been revalidated for this head.

Validation before the test-fixture follow-up, on combined stack `4cf27a551c`: 455 tests and 921 subtests passed on B300, plus the two widened-history regressions against Rust TreeCore. The new FULL-fallback metadata cases cover eager execution and CUDA graph replay. New allocation-reclaim, explicit-prefill and JIT-reuse regressions fail on the previous code and pass with the fixes. These are combined-stack checks, not independent model reruns of each PR.

81 tests and 40 subtests passed on B300 at the previous head `fe3202b894`, covering decode metadata, graph replay, fused placement, unified speculative admission, and page-major backend policy.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

The following throughput and exact-output measurements are from the previous stack revision, before the review fixes.

**Prior combined-stack validation** at `fe3202b894ef1cb045e2ff6b816558927bbdc055`, based on main `3671503e44`:

Inkling-Small-NVFP4 (revision `b6a99534467840620d411e4cd4ad5819b2610d9c`) with Inkling-Small-DSpark (revision `736501c3901cfc6bbb53ba382781eb0e5d9ad66a`), 4x B300 / TP4, FA4 target and draft, CUDA graphs, page size 128, greedy decoding, 48 requests with fixed synthetic 512-token inputs and 2048 output tokens. Default and unified runs used identical inputs and model revisions. The test flushed the prefix cache between cases, performed a 128-token warmup, then an exact-output run with logprobs and two throughput runs without logprobs.

- Exact output token IDs: 48/48 requests match.
- Per-request verify counts: 48/48 match.
- Aggregate accept length (completion tokens / verify count): default 4.43470023, unified 4.43470023.
- Output throughput, two runs: default 8486.2 / 8484.6 tok/s; unified 8548.8 / 8552.7 tok/s.

This validates the combined stack on one controlled workload; it is not an isolated before/after benchmark of any individual optimization or a task-accuracy evaluation. PyTorch 2.14.1+cu130, Triton 3.8, FlashInfer 0.7.1. Main arguments: `--tp 4 --attention-backend fa4 --speculative-algorithm DSPARK --speculative-draft-attention-backend fa4 --page-size 128 --mem-fraction-static 0.8 --max-running-requests 48 --mamba-radix-cache-strategy extra_buffer --swa-full-tokens-ratio 0.1 --mamba-full-memory-ratio 0.1 --random-seed 1234`; `SGLANG_RAGGED_VERIFY_MODE=static`. Only the unified arm adds `--enable-unified-memory`.


## Checklist

- [x] Commit pre-commit hooks passed.
- [x] Regression tests passed on the combined stack; earlier individual-head results are labeled above.
- [x] Followed SGLang code style.
- [ ] Upstream CI pending.

+    zero_tail: bool = False,
 ):
     """Fill sequence lengths, their prefix sum and page tables in one launch.
 
-    ``req_to_token`` contains token slots. Static SWA uses
-    ``full_to_swa_index_mapping`` to map FULL token slots to SWA token slots.

-    computes only lengths and the prefix sum.
+    ``req_to_token`` contains token slots. ``full_v2p`` / ``swa_v2p`` map
+    virtual pages to physical pages; an unbound (-1) page maps to the sink.
+    Static SWA instead uses ``full_to_swa_index_mapping`` to map token slots.
+    Supply exactly one SWA mapping when writing ``swa_page_table``. Mappings
+    are read on device on every invocation, including CUDA graph replay.
+
+    Only the live prefix (ceil((seq_len + delta) / page_size)) is rewritten
+    by default; consumers must bound reads by ``cache_seqlens_int32``.
+    ``zero_tail=True`` also clears columns up to ``max_seq_pages`` to zero,
+    independently of address translation. ``skip_page_table=True`` leaves
+    both page tables untouched and computes only lengths and the prefix sum.

         f"page_size must be a power of two, got {page_size}"
     )
